author: Dude Perfect
description:
Welcome to Rocket League IRL! We brought the legendary video game to real life for this EPIC battle, featuring Rocket League soccer, golf, hockey and archery tag!

From PS5 to real life - thanks to @PlayStation for helping us take the unforgettable world of Rocket League IRL. #ItHappensOnPS5 #PlayStationPlaymakers #ad 

Text “ROCKET LEAGUE” to 398294 to stay updated. 

►Thank you to Credit Union of Texas Event Center, entertainment headquarters of North Texas, for allowing us to bring Rocket League to life! For more info and upcoming events, please visit https://www.cutxeventcenter.com/.

►Huge shoutout to Arcis Golf and their club, Lake Park Golf Club in Lewisville, Texas, for hosting us! Visit Arcis Golf at arcisgolf.com or @arcisgolf on Instagram. You can check out Lake Park Golf Club at arcisgolf.com/clubs/lake_park_golf_course or @lakeparkgolfcourse on Instagram.
